semiconductor_relevance: High — Sumitronics Taiwan specializes in supplying advanced materials for semiconductor manufacturing and has a strong presence in the industry.
summary: Sumitronics Taiwan Co., Ltd is a key supplier of high-quality materials for the semiconductor, flat panel display (FPD), and LED industries. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sumitomo Corporation, the company provides optimal solutions including warehousing and logistics services to meet customer needs.
capabilities: Logistics and warehousing solutions for semiconductor manufacturing
Development of materials for FPD and LED industries
technical_expertise: Logistics optimization in semiconductor supply chains

regional_presence.Taiwan: Sumitronics has offices near Hsinchu and Tainan Science Park, supporting numerous high-tech companies in the region.
